notes: A Test button for the vision endpoint. The bare gateway 500 from the last log means the worker behind the vision endpoint ID doesn't speak the OpenAI chat protocol at all — the classic cause being the image endpoint's ID pasted into the vision field, or a non-vLLM deployment. Settings now has 'Test vision endpoint': one tap checks the ID and key (health), then sends a tiny chat request and prints a plain-language verdict — wrong ID or key, not-a-vLLM-endpoint, model name mismatch, or working, with the model's reply as proof. The same-ID mistake is also caught outright when sending a photo, with a message saying exactly what to fix instead of retrying a doomed request.
